title: Mastodon Snowflake ID
summary: Mastodon uses a Snowflake-style 64-bit ID: 41-bit millisecond timestamp (custom epoch 2018-01-01), 10-bit worker ID, and 12-bit sequence number. Unlike Twitter's Snowflake, Mastodon's epoch starts on 2018-01-01T00:00:00Z.

notes: 12-bit sequence number (4096 IDs per millisecond per worker).
64-bit total fits in a signed 64-bit integer.
